messages:
maria: Quick heads-up 1: Predictor GA prep. Need to lock SLA targets, docs owner, support rota, monitoring dashboard owners, and pricing slug. Short sync please.
ajay: EOM still the plan? :calendar:
maria: yep EOM. small staged rollout: hosted -> reserved dedicated -> enterprise pilots.
liz: happy to own docs. I'll need sample prompts, expected error payloads, and a short FAQ for early customers.
ajay: SLA draft: hosted 99.95% uptime, P95 latency <250ms; dedicated 99.9%, P95 <450ms. fallback to lite-model when overloaded.
samir: add degraded-mode SLOs: when fallback active, mark system as degraded but preserve correctness. alert on sustained fallback. propose alert if fallback_rate > 0.5% for 15m.
maria: good. also add a metric when fallback causes >5% increase in average token cost. ops-bot: alert-rule created: predictor.fallback_rate > 0.5% for 15m -> #eng-oncall.
nathan: I can cover primary support for first 10 business days. will need a concise runbook link and escalation matrix.
liz: docs checklist I'll start: quickstart, SDK snippets, SLO table, error codes, rollback steps, customer SLA summary, known limits. PR in 48h.
ajay: pricing proposal: tiered per-token for hosted (starter: $0.0012/token gen; standard: $0.0008/token gen), dedicated = reserved GPU tier + discounted per-token for burst. also produce $/request examples for small prompts.
maria: product wants example enterprise contract blurb (Uptime, credits, response windows). ajay can you sketch?
ajay: will send examples + sample contracts. also we need telemetry hook in payload: customer_id + route_tag. include opt-out for privacy.
samir: security: telemetry default on for enterprise but opt-out available. PII must never be logged. security sign-off required before GA.
liz: will add a "what to expect during bursts" section and a short troubleshooting matrix for oncall. tagging @maria @nathan for review.
maria: Decision list: (1) SLA numbers above tentative, (2) docs owner = liz, (3) support rota initial = nathan, (4) pricing draft = ajay, (5) alert thresholds and runbook = samir. thumbs? :thumbsup:
ajay: +1
liz: +1
samir: +1
nathan: +1
maria: I'll run a 20m shiproom tomorrow to lock wording and cut the pricing proposal. ops-bot: deploy-preview: predictor-v0.9 -> staging started by maria at 4321987672
ajay: staging smoke plan: load test 50k reqs/min, validate fallback and billing tags. want volunteers to watch metrics?
samir: I'll run load at 14:00 PT and post logs here. capturing p95, fallback rate, error rates, and billing tags.
maria: great 1 make sure to record billing tag propagation end-to-end and validate SLO dashboards. we'll reconvene after results for final sign-off.
